summary: Reads the list head pointer from this, positions the list cursor at the first node (overwriting the cursor at node offset 8 with the first node pointer), and returns true only when the list is non-empty and the first node holds a non-null data pointer. Used to begin file/directory enumeration.

operations.description: Load the list head structure pointer from this+0.
Load the first node pointer from the head structure at offset 0 and its data pointer.
Test whether the first node pointer is null (empty list).
Overwrite the cursor at node offset 8 with the first node pointer.
Return true only if the list is non-empty and the first node's data pointer is non-null.

unresolved: The caller-side interpretation of the returned boolean beyond 'cursor positioned at first node' is not derivable from this function alone.
